_comment: The queryable interface for query_data: which tables and columns may be read.
It lives in a DATA file on purpose -- pointing the bot at your own database must be a data
change, not a code change. Override the path with BUSINESS_SCHEMA_FILE; when the file is
missing, the built-in defaults in server/memory.py apply (so a fresh clone still works).
tables : table -> every queryable column. Each table and column must exist in the database.
text   : table -> columns that `search` scans with LIKE. 'search' is ignored (and now errors)
for a table that has none, which is why every table below lists at least one.
numeric: table -> columns that avg / max / min / sum may aggregate.
Tables not listed here are unreachable by the model: conversation history (turns), long-term
memory (facts), and the knowledge base stay private.
